zotero.abstractNote: Streaming motion synthesis aims to generate long-term human motion in real-time, which is crucial for interactive applications like VR/AR and robotics. Existing methods often struggle with long-term consistency and the trade-off between generation speed and motion quality. In this paper, we propose ActionPlan, a novel framework for future-aware streaming motion synthesis. Instead of directly predicting the next pose, ActionPlan introduces a frame-level action planning module that predicts a sequence of future action tokens. These tokens act as a high-level guide for the motion generator, ensuring long-term coherence while maintaining real-time performance. We demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of motion quality and temporal consistency on standard benchmarks.
